notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
New interiors: Added abandoned factory, new buildings.

The lighting system in the rooms has been redesigned, creating a more realistic and tense atmosphere. Shadows play a key role, and the play of light and darkness adds mystery.

Performance Optimization: Optimization work has been done to improve game performance, especially in indoor environments.

Various bugs have been fixed, including problems with character animation and object interaction.
